description: This file is a shell script utilizing ucode for wireless network configuration in OpenWRT, handling setup and teardown of Wi-Fi interfaces, including mesh, station, and access point modes, with external dependencies on Wi-Fi related modules.

methods.name: phy_suffix
methods.description: Generates a suffix for PHY based on radio number and separator.

methods.name: reset_config
methods.description: Resets Wi-Fi configuration for a given PHY and radio.

methods.name: get_channel_frequency
methods.description: Calculates the frequency for a given band and channel.

methods.name: setup_phy
methods.description: Configures PHY settings including antenna, power, and frequency.

methods.name: iw_htmode
methods.description: Determines the HT mode string based on configuration.

methods.name: config_add
methods.description: Adds a configuration parameter if value is not null.

methods.name: setup
methods.description: Main function to set up Wi-Fi interfaces and services.

methods.name: teardown
methods.description: Tears down Wi-Fi configuration and resets PHY.
